guard: The simulator delivers parked timed effects in wake order on one virtual clock, so concurrent branches accumulate the durations they wrote; delivery in ask order is the old shared-serial-clock behavior that decided races by the order effects were asked. (FAIL-FAST suite: markers are upstream of the cells they guard.)

mutations.name: the pump pops in ask order and ignores wake times
mutations.find: if (next === undefined || e.wake < next.wake || (e.wake === next.wake && e.seq < next.seq)) next = e;
mutations.replace: if (next === undefined || e.seq < next.seq) next = e;
mutations.expectRed: two parked sleeps deliver in wake order, not ask order, each at its own wake
mutations.completionMarker: ok script entries the run never reached are named
mutations.cell: two parked sleeps deliver in wake order, not ask order, each at its own wake
mutations.note: Ask-order delivery hands the 5m sleep its wake first and the clock never goes back, so both arrive stamped 300000 in ask order; every sequential cell upstream is indifferent to the pop rule and keeps the marker green.
